description: This file provides ostream support for the formatting library, including classes and functions for formatting objects with ostream operators, writing buffers to streams, and printing formatted output to std::ostream.

classes.name: basic_ostream_formatter
classes.description: Formatter class for objects that have an overloaded ostream operator<<, supporting formatting to basic_string_view.

classes.name: streamed_view
classes.description: A view that formats a value via an ostream operator<<, used for streaming objects.

classes.name: file_access
classes.description: Template class for accessing FILE* from file buffer objects, with specializations based on compiler and STL version.

methods.name: write_buffer
methods.description: Writes the contents of a buffer to a std::basic_ostream.

methods.name: streamed
methods.description: Returns a streamed_view for a given value, enabling ostream-style formatting.

methods.name: vprint
methods.description: Prints formatted data to a std::ostream, handling platform-specific details.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints formatted data to a std::ostream with variadic arguments.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Prints formatted data followed by a newline to a std::ostream.
